packageRules.description: optative-script pins an rquickjs major, and tauler uses rquickjs types directly at the UI-component registration boundary (src/ui/registry.rs, src/jsx.rs). Two rquickjs versions in the graph make `Ctx`/`Error` fail to unify, so a lone bump of any one of these never compiles.
takumi re-exports takumi-core types; a lone bump of either puts two takumi-core versions in the graph and the ImageSource/ImageBuffer types stop unifying.
Starlight and its themes/integrations peer-depend on the Astro major.
Action digest bumps are independent and noisy; one PR is enough.
